question: What sequence of teaching and knowledge is announced to the brahmin?
premises: Something will be spoken first to the brahmin.
inference: The text announces that something will be spoken first, and then all will know.
uncertainties: The referent of sakalānāṃ and the subject of viduḥ are unclear without further context.
plain_english: O brahmin, it will be spoken first, and then they know of all.
